cards.name: Arrakis Observer
cards.text:
Arrakis Observer cost 3 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

You can send an agent to City or Spice Trade spaces. You may discard a card from your hand to place a Spy with Deep Cover (you have the option to ignore any opponents’ Spies when you place it). If you discarded a Spacing Guild card gain 2 spice.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and you may recall a Spy to gain 3 swords.

cards.text:
CHOAM Demands cost 6 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

On reveal if you have completed four or more contracts you may trash this card to gain 1 Influence with Emperor, Spacing Guild, Bene Gesserit, and Fremen factions.

cards.name: Kwisatz Haderach
cards.text:
Kwisatz Haderach cost 8 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

You may play this card to take an Agent turn even if you have no Agents left in your supply, as it lets you send an Agent that is already on a board space. You may send an Agent back to the space that it was just on.

If a board space can be used only once per game (High Council, Swordmaster), you can’t use Kwisatz Haderach to send an Agent there more than once. You can’t overcome The Voice and send an Agent to a board space where you can’t send an Agent.

If you move an agent away from a space with a Maker icon, and that space remains empty until Phase 4, bonus spice does accumulate there.

On reveal card has no reveal effects.

You can send an agent to City spaces. You may pay 2 spice to gain 1 Influence with Spacing Guild faction and 3 solari.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Stilgar
cards.text:
Stilgar cost 5 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an agent to Fremen, City, or Spice Trade spaces. Gain 1 water.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion and 3 swords.

cards.name: Test of Humanity
cards.text:
Test of Humanity cost 3 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

You can send an agent to Bene Gesserit, Landsraad, or City spaces. 
Each opponent chooses: Discard a card or Lose a deployed troop.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion.

cards.name: The Voice
cards.text:
The Voice cost 2 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

You can send an agent to City or Spice Trade spaces. Choose any board space. Opponents can't send their next Agents there this round.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion.

cards.name: Thufir Hawat
cards.text:
Thufir Hawat cost 5 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Emperor, Spacing Guild, Bene Gesserit, Fremen, City, or Spice Trade spaces. Draw 1 card from your deck.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and draw 1 Intrigue.

cards.name: Worm Riders
cards.text:
Worm Riders cost 6 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an Agent to City or Spice Trade spaces. Gain 2 spice.

On reveal if you have 2 Influence with Fremen gain 4 swords and if you have Fremen Alliance gain 2 additional swords

cards.name: Bene Tleilax Lab
cards.text:
Bene Tleilax Lab cost 2 persuasion.

You can send an agent to City or Spice Trade spaces. Place a specimen.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and if you reach the first genetic marker gain 1 spice

cards.name: Bene Tleilax Researcher
cards.text:
Bene Tleilax Researcher cost 4 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Landsraad spaces. This card has graft effect (it can’t be played alone).

Advance your research token one space to the right on the research track.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and if you reach the first genetic marker gain 1 additional persuasion and if you reach the second genetic marker gain 1 more persuasion.

cards.name: Blank Slate
cards.text:
Blank Slate cost 1 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Landsraad, City, or Spice Trade spaces. 
If grafted: This card has Emperor, Spacing Guild, Bene Gesserit, and Fremen faction tags.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Clandestine Meeting
cards.text:
Clandestine Meeting cost 4 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

(This card has no Agent icons.) 
Gain 1 Influence with Bene Gesserit and draw 1 Intrigue.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion.

cards.name: Corrupt Smuggler
cards.text:
Corrupt Smuggler cost 3 persuasion, has Spacing Guild and Fremen faction tags.

You can send an agent to Spacing Guild or Spice Trade spaces. 
If grafted: gain 2 spice.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Dissecting Kit
cards.text:
Dissecting Kit cost 2 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Landsraad or City spaces. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). Trash the other grafted card to place a specimen.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and if you reach the first genetic marker advance your Tleilaxu token.

cards.name: For Humanity
cards.text:
For Humanity cost 7 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

You can send an agent to Bene Gesserit, Landsraad, or Spice Trade spaces. Gain 1 Influence with any Faction.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion and if you have Bene Gesserit Alliance you may lose 2 Influence with any one Faction to gain 1 victory point.

cards.name: High Priority Travel
cards.text:
High Priority Travel cost 1 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

You can send an agent to Landsraad or Spice Trade spaces. 
If you have 2 Influence with Spacing Guild: draw 1 card from your deck or you may deploy troops to the Conflict.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 solari.

cards.name: Imperium Ceremony
cards.text:
Imperium Ceremony cost 6 persuasion, has Emperor and Spacing Guild faction tags.

You can send an agent to Emperor, Spacing Guild, or Landsraad spaces. 
Look at the top two cards of the Intrigue deck. Keep one and put the other back on top.

On reveal you gain 3 persuasion.

cards.name: Interstellar Conspiracy
cards.text:
Interstellar Conspiracy cost 4 persuasion.

You can send an agent to City spaces. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). Gain 1 spice and if grafted with an Emperor or Spacing Guild card gain 1 Influence with any Faction.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion.

cards.name: Keys To Power
cards.text:
Keys to Power cost 5 persuasion, has Spacing Guild and Bene Gesserit faction tags.

You can send an agent to Spacing Guild, Bene Gesserit, or Landsraad spaces. If you have 2 Influence with Emperor: gain 2 spice.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion.

cards.name: Lisan Al Gaib
cards.text:
Lisan al Gaib cost 4 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit and Fremen faction tags. 
On acquire: gain 1 spice.

You can send an agent to Fremen, City, or Spice Trade spaces. If you have another Bene Gesserit card in play: gain 1 Influence with Fremen.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and if you have Fremen Bond you gain 2 swords.

cards.name: Long Reach
cards.text:
Long Reach cost 6 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

By default card has no agent icons.
If you have another Bene Gesserit card in play, this has Landsraad, City, and Spice Trade agent icons. 
Choose two: gain 1 Influence with Emperor, gain 1 Influence with Spacing Guild, gain 1 Influence with Bene Gesserit, or gain 1 Influence with Fremen.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and draw 1 Intrigue.

cards.name: Occupation
cards.text:
Occupation cost 8 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag. 
On acquire: recruit 3 troops.

You can send an agent to Emperor, Spacing Guild, Bene Gesserit, Fremen, City, or Spice Trade spaces. Draw 1 card from your deck and you may deploy troops to the Conflict.

On reveal you gain 1 water, 1 spice, and recruit 1 troop.

cards.name: Organ Merchants
cards.text:
Organ Merchants cost 3 persuasion.

You can send an agent to City or Spice Trade spaces. You may pay 1 specimen to gain 4 solari.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 solari.

cards.name: Planned Coupling
cards.text:
Planned Coupling cost 3 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

You can send an agent to Bene Gesserit locations. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). Draw 1 card from your deck.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Replacement Eyes
cards.text:
Replacement Eyes cost 5 persuasion.

You can send an agent to City spaces. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). When this card is trashed: advance your Tleilaxu token. 
You may trash one card from your hand, discard pile, or in play to draw 1 card from your deck.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Sardaukar Quartermaster
cards.text:
Sardaukar Quartermaster cost 2 persuasion, has Emperor faction tag.

You can send an agent to Landsraad or City spaces. 
If grafted: recruit 1 troop and draw 1 card from your deck.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 2 swords.

cards.name: Shadout Mapes
cards.text:
Shadout Mapes cost 2 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an agent to Fremen or Spice Trade spaces.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword and you may deploy or retreat one of your troops.

cards.name: Show Of Strength
cards.text:
Show of Strength cost 3 persuasion, has Emperor and Fremen faction tags.

If you have more deployed troops than each opponent, this has Landsraad and Spice Trade agent icons. Draw 2 cards from your deck.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 2 swords.

cards.name: Spiritual Fervor
cards.text:
Spiritual Fervor cost 3 persuasion. 
On acquire: advance your research token.

You can send an agent to Spice Trade spaces.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and place a specimen.

cards.name: Stillsuit Manufacturer
cards.text:
Stillsuit Manufacturer cost 5 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an agent to Fremen or City spaces. Gain 1 water and if you have Fremen Alliance return this card from play to your hand.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and if you have Fremen Bond you gain 2 spice.

cards.name: Throne Room Politics
cards.text:
Throne Room Politics cost 4 persuasion, has Emperor and Bene Gesserit faction tags.

You can send an agent to Emperor spaces. Recruit 1 troop and you may trash one card from your hand, discard pile, or in play..

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and gain 1 Influence with Bene Gesserit.

cards.name: Tleilaxu Master
cards.text:
Tleilaxu Master cost 5 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Landsraad or Spice Trade spaces. 
If you reach the first genetic marker: you may acquire a card that costs 6 or less. If you reach the second genetic marker: put that card in your hand.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and advance your research token twice.

cards.name: Tleilaxu Surgeon
cards.text:
Tleilaxu Surgeon cost 3 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Emperor or City spaces. You may pay 2 specimens to advance your Tleilaxu token twice.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion and you may lose two troops to place 2 specimens.

cards.name: Arrakis Revolt
cards.text:
Arrakis Revolt cost 6 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag. 
On acquire: gain 1 troop.

You can send an agent to City spaces. If you have Maker Hooks you may pay 2 spices to remove Shield Wall token from the game board (optional) and summon and deploy one sandworm.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 3 swords.

cards.name: Boundless Ambition
cards.text:
Boundless Ambition cost 5 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Emperor, Spacing Guild, Bene Gesserit, or Fremen locations. 
Activate your Leader's Signet Ring ability.

 On reveal, on discard, on trash: Acquire a card that costs 5 persuasion or less.

cards.name: Duncan, Loyal Blade
cards.text:
Duncan, Loyal Blade cost 5 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Fremen or City spaces. Recruit 1 troop.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 2 swords and you may trash this card to deploy or retreat any number of your troops from or to your garrison.

cards.name: Jessica of Arrakis
cards.text:
Jessica of Arrakis cost 3 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

You can send an agent to Spice Trade spaces. If you have another Bene Gesserit card in play: draw 2 cards from your deck.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 2 swords.

cards.name: Pivotal Gambit
cards.text:
Pivotal Gambit cost 3 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an Agent to Fremen or City spaces. Trash this card to recruit 1 troop and add "Gain 1 Influence with any Faction" to the first place reward for this conflict.

On reveal gain 1 persuasion and 2 swords

cards.name: Ruthless Leadeship
cards.text:
Ruthless Leadership cost 4 persuasion, has Emperor faction tag.

You can send an Agent to City or Spice Trade spaces. 
If you have one or more Sardaukar Commanders in the Conflict: trash 2 cards from your hand, discard pile, or in play.

On reveal gain 1 persuasion, 1 sword and if you have 6 persuasion or more you may deploy troops to the Conflict.

cards.name: The Beast's Spoils
cards.text:
The Beast's Spoils cost 3 persuasion, has Emperor faction tag.

You can send an Agent to City spaces. 
Gain rewards for your face-up battle icons: 
Crysknife: trash one card from your hand, discard pile, or in play; 
Desert Mouse: gain 1 spice; 
Maker Hooks: recruit 1 troop.

On reveal gain 3 swords

cards.name: Thumper
cards.text:
Thumper cost 3 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an Agent to Spice Trade spaces. Double the bonus spice you harvest with this Agent.

On reveal gain 1 persuasion and gain 1 spice

cards.name: Appropriate
cards.text:
Appropriate cost 5 persuasion, has Emperor faction tag. 
On acquire: move your Freighter (advance or recall).

You can send an agent to Landsraad or Spice Trade spaces. 
If you have 2 Influence with Emperor: acquire Tech. You may use solari instead of spice for this purchase.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion.

cards.name: Bounty Hunter
cards.text:
Bounty Hunter cost 1 persuasion.

You may infiltrate City spaces. If used to send an Agent to a board space with an enemy Agent: gain 2 solari.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: CHOAM Delegate
cards.text:
CHOAM Delegate cost 1 persuasion.

You may infiltrate Spice Trade spaces.

Unload gain 3 solari.

cards.name: Court Intrigue
cards.text:
Court Intrigue cost 2 persuasion, has Emperor faction tag.

You may infiltrate Emperor spaces. You may put one of your Intrigue cards on the bottom of the Intrigue deck to draw 1 Intrigue.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Desert Ambush
cards.text:
Desert Ambush cost 3 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an agent to Spice Trade spaces. For each troop you deploy this turn, you may force an enemy unit to retreat.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Embedded Agent
cards.text:
Embedded Agent cost 5 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

You may infiltrate Landsraad spaces. If you have another Bene Gesserit card in play: move your Freighter (advance or recall) twice.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and draw 1 Intrigue.

cards.name: Esmar Tuek
cards.text:
Esmar Tuek cost 5 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

You can send an agent to City or Spice Trade spaces. You may pay 1 spice to gain 1 Influence with Spacing Guild and draw 1 card from your deck.

Unload gain 2 spice and 2 solari.

cards.name: Freighter Fleet
cards.text:
Freighter Fleet cost 2 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Spice Trade spaces.

Unload move your Freighter (advance or recall).

cards.name: Full-Scale Assault
cards.text:
Full-Scale Assault cost 8 persuasion, has Emperor faction tag. 
On acquire: commission one dreadnought.

You can send an agent to Emperor or City spaces. Recruit 2 troops.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion and 3 swords for each of your dreadnoughts in the Conflict.

cards.name: Guild Accord
cards.text:
Guild Accord cost 6 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

You may infiltrate Spacing Guild locations. 
It costs 2 spice less to send an Agent to the Heighliner board space with this card.

Unload: gain 1 water and if you have Spacing Guild Alliance gain 3 spice.

cards.name: Guild Chief Administrator
cards.text:
Guild Chief Administrator cost 4 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

You can send an agent to Spacing Guild, City, or Spice Trade spaces. You may discard a card from your hand to trash this card.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and move your Freighter (advance or recall).

cards.name: Imperial Bashar
cards.text:
Imperial Bashar cost 4 persuasion, has Emperor faction tag.

You can send an agent to City spaces. 
Recruit 1 troop or may trash one card from your hand, discard pile, or in play.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 2 swords and gain 1 additional sword for each other revealed card that provides one or more swords this turn.

cards.name: Imperial Shock Trooper
cards.text:
Imperial Shock Trooper cost 3 persuasion, has Emperor faction tag.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 2 swords and if you have an Agent on an Emperor board space gain 3 additional swords.

cards.name: In The Shadows
cards.text:
In The Shadows cost 2 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

You can send an agent to Landsraad or City spaces. 
If you have 2 Influence with Bene Gesserit: choose one: discard a card from your hand to gain 1 Influence with Emperor, gain 1 Influence with Spacing Guild, or gain 1 Influence with Fremen.

Unload gain 1 Influence with Bene Gesserit.

cards.name: Ix-Guild Compact
cards.text:
Ix-Guild Compact cost 3 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

You can send an agent to Spacing Guild locations. You may discard 2 cards from your hand to commission one dreadnought.

Unload: take 2 troops from your supply and place them as a Negotiator on the Ix board.

cards.name: Ixian Engineer
cards.text:
Ixian Engineer cost 5 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Spice Trade spaces. You may acquire tech when send an Agent using this card.

On reveal if you have three or more Tech tiles: you may trash this card to gain 1 victory point

cards.name: Jamis
cards.text:
Jamis cost 2 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You may infiltrate Fremen locations. 
You may trash one card from your hand, discard pile, or in play.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 2 swords.

cards.name: Landing Rights
cards.text:
Landing Rights cost 4 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

You can send an agent to City spaces. Move your Freighter (advance or recall).

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion.

cards.name: Local Fence
cards.text:
Local Fence cost 3 persuasion.

You can send an agent to City spaces. You may pay 2 spice to gain 5 solari or pay 5 solari to gain 4 spice.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion.

cards.name: Negotiated Withdrawal
cards.text:
Negotiated Withdrawal cost 4 persuasion. 
On acquire: recruit 1 troop.

You can send an agent to Landsraad, City, or Spice Trade spaces.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion and retreat three of your units to gain 1 Influence with any Faction.

cards.name: Satellite Ban
cards.text:
Satellite Ban cost 5 persuasion, has Spacing Guild and Fremen faction tags.

You can send an agent to Spacing Guild or Fremen locations. You may discard a card from your hand to gain 1 spice and 1 water.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and you may retreat up to two of your troops.

cards.name: Sayyadina
cards.text:
Sayyadina cost 3 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit and Fremen faction tags.

You can send an agent to Bene Gesserit or Fremen locations. You may pay 3 water to gain 1 victory point.

On reveal if you have Fremen Bond you gain 3 persuasion.

cards.name: Shai-Hulud
cards.text:
Shai-Hulud cost 7 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag. 
On acquire: you may trash one card from your hand, discard pile, or in play.

You can send an agent to Spice Trade spaces. 
You may trash one card from your hand, discard pile, or in play to recruit 2 troops.

On reveal if you have Fremen Bond you gain 5 swords.

cards.name: Spice Trader
cards.text:
Spice Trader cost 4 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an agent to City or Spice Trade spaces. If you have 2 Influence with Fremen: you may discard a card from your hand to gain 2 spice.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Treachery
cards.text:
Treachery cost 6 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Emperor, Spacing Guild, Bene Gesserit, or Fremen locations. Gain two Influence instead of one. Trash this card.

Unload recruit 2 troops. Deploy these troops to the Conflict (mandatory action).

cards.name: Truthsayer
cards.text:
Truthsayer cost 3 persuasion, has Emperor and Bene Gesserit faction tags.

You can send an agent to Emperor, Bene Gesserit, or Landsraad spaces. You may discard a card from your hand to draw 1 card from your deck.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Water Peddler
cards.text:
Water Peddler cost 1 persuasion. 
On acquire: gain 1 water.

Unload gain 1 water.

cards.name: Web of Power
Weirding Way
cards.text:
Weirding Way cost 3 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

You can send an agent to City or Spice Trade spaces. You may take another turn immediately after this one.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 2 swords.

cards.name: Bene Gesserit Operative
cards.text:
Bene Gesserit Operative cost 3 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

You can send an agent to Bene Gesserit locations. You may place a Spy from your supply on an unoccupied observation post on the board.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and if you have two or more Spies on the board gain 2 additional persuasion.

cards.name: Branching Path
cards.text:
Branching Path cost 3 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag.

You can send an agent to Bene Gesserit or City locations. If you have Bene Gesserit Alliance you may trash an Intrigue card to draw 1 Intrigue and gain 2 spice.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion.

cards.name: Calculus of Power
cards.text:
Calculus of Power cost 3 persuasion, has Emperor faction tag.

You can send an agent to City spaces or to a board space connected to an observation post where you currently have a Spy. You may trash one card from your hand, discard pile, or in play.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion and you may trash another Emperor card you have in play to gain 3 swords.

cards.name: Captured Mentat
cards.text:
Captured Mentat cost 5 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Landsraad or Spice Trade spaces. You may discard a card from your hand to draw 1 Intrigue and draw a card from your deck.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and you may lose 1 Influence with any Faction to gain 1 Influence with any Faction.

cards.name: Cargo Runner
cards.text:
Cargo Runner cost 3 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

You can send an agent to Landsraad, City, or Spice Trade spaces. If you have completed two or more contracts draw a card from your deck. If you have completed four or more contracts draw an additional card from your deck.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Chani, Clever Tactician
cards.text:
Chani, Clever Tactician cost 5 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an agent to Fremen, City, or Spice Trade spaces. If you have three or more units in the Conflict draw 1 Intrigue.

On reveal you may retreat two of your troops to gain 4 swords and if you have Fremen Bond gain 2 persuasion.

cards.name: Corrinth City
cards.text:
Corrinth City cost 6 persuasion, has Emperor faction tag.

You can send an agent to Emperor or Landsraad locations. You may discard 2 cards from your hand and pay 5 solari to gain 1 victory point.

On reveal you gain 5 solari or you may pay 5 solari to take your seat on the High Council (if you haven't already).

cards.name: Covert Operation
cards.text:
Covert Operation cost 3 persuasion.

You can send an agent to a board space connected to an observation post where you currently have a Spy. Each opponent discards a card.

On reveal you gain 2 spies.

cards.name: Dangerous Rhetoric
cards.text:
Dangerous Rhetoric cost 3 persuasion.

You can send an agent to Landsraad spaces or to a board space connected to an observation post where you currently have a Spy. 
When you send an agent using this card: Gain one Influence. Choose any one
of the four Factions. You must trash this card.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Delivery Agreement
cards.text:
Delivery Agreement cost 5 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

You can send an agent to City spaces. You may discard a card from your hand to take a face-up contract.

On reveal you gain 1 spice or if you have completed four or more contracts you may trash this card to gain 1 victory point.

cards.name: Desert Power
cards.text:
Desert Power cost 6 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an agent to Spice Trade spaces. If you sent an Agent to a Maker board space this turn gain 2 spice.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion or if you have Maker Hooks you may pay water to summon and deploy one sandworm

cards.name: Desert Survival
cards.text:
Desert Survival cost 2 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an agent to Spice Trade spaces. You may trash one card from your hand, discard pile, or in play

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Double Agent
cards.text:
Double Agent cost 3 persuasion, has Emperor and Spacing Guild faction tags.

You can send an agent to Landsraad, City, or Spice Trade spaces. Place a Spy from your supply on the board space you sent an Agent to this turn. You may place this Spy on the same observation post as another player's Spy.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Ecological Testing Station
cards.text:
Ecological Testing Station cost 3 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.
You can send an agent to Fremen or City locations.
You may pay 2 water to draw 2 cards.
On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and if you have Fremen Bond gain 1 water.

cards.name: Fedaykin Stilltent
cards.text:
Fedaykin Stilltent cost 2 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an agent to Spice Trade space. If you sent an Agent to a Maker board space this turn you gain 1 troop.

On reveal you gain 1 water.

cards.name: Guild Envoy
cards.text:
Guild Envoy cost 3 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

You can send an agent to Emperor, Spacing Guild, Bene Gesserit, or Fremen locations. When you send an agent using this card: you must discard a card from your hand. If you discarded a Spacing Guild card you draw 2 cards.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Guild Spy
cards.text:
Guild Spy cost 3 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag. 
On acquire: you may place a Spy from your supply on an unoccupied observation post on the board.

You can send an agent to a board space connected to an observation post where you currently have a Spy. 
When you send an agent using this card: you may discard a card from your hand to draw a card. If you discarded a Spacing Guild card you draw 1 Intrigue.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion and if you acquire The Spice Must Flow this turn, gain one Influence with each Faction you are spying on.

cards.name: Hidden Missive
cards.text:
Hidden Missive cost 2 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit faction tag. 

You can send an agent to Landsraad locations using this card.
 If you have 2 influence on Bene Gesserit faction you recruit one troop and draw card. 

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Imperial Spymaster
cards.text:
Imperial Spymaster cost 2 persuasion, has Emperor faction tag.

You can send an agent to Emperor locations or to a board space connected to an observation post where you currently have a Spy. If you recalled a Spy this turn you draw 1 Intrigue.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: In High Places
cards.text:
In High Places cost 5 persuasion, has Emperor and Bene Gesserit faction tags. On acquire: you may place a Spy from your supply on an unoccupied observation post on the board.

You can send an agent to Emperor or Bene Gesserit locations. 
If you have another Bene Gesserit card in play: draw a card from your deck and place a Spy from your supply on an unoccupied observation post on the board.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion and you may recall 2 spies to gain 3 additional persuasion.

cards.name: Interstellar Trade
cards.text:
Interstellar Trade cost 7 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag. 
On acquire: take a face-up contract.

You can send an agent to Landsraad, City, or Spice Trade spaces. 
Gain 1 Influence with any Faction.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion for each contract you have completed.

cards.name: Junction Headquarters
cards.text:
Junction Headquarters cost 6 persuasion, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

You can send an agent to Landsraad, City, or Spice Trade spaces. If you have Spacing Guild Alliance you may trash an Intrigue card and pay 2 spice to gain 1 victory point.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion, 1 water, and 1 troop.

cards.name: Leadership
cards.text:
Leadership cost 5 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an agent to Fremen or Spice Trade locations. For each sandworm you have in the Conflict draw a card from your deck.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion, 1 sword and 1 additional sword for each other revealed card that provides one or more swords this turn.

cards.name: Long Live the Fighters
cards.text:
Long Live the Fighters cost 7 persuasion, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an agent to Fremen or City locations. If your deck has three or more cards, look at the top three cards. Draw one, discard one, and trash one (trash is mandatory).

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion and 3 swords.

cards.name: Maker Keeper
cards.text:
Maker Keeper cost 2 persuasion, has Bene Gesserit and Fremen faction tags.

You can send an agent to City spaces.
If you have 2 influence on Bene Gesserit faction - gain 1 water.
If you have 2 influence on Fremen faction - gain 1 spice.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion.

cards.name: Maula Pistol
cards.text:

You can send an agent to City spaces. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). At the start of your Reveal turn, return the other grafted card from play to your hand.

On reveal you gain 2 persuasion.

cards.name: Contaminator
cards.text:
Contaminator cost 1 specimen, has Fremen faction tag.

You can send an agent to Fremen locations. Advance your Tleilaxu token.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Corrino Genes
cards.text:
Corrino Genes cost 1 specimen, has Emperor faction tag. 
On acquire: gain 2 solari.

You can send an agent to Emperor spaces. If grafted: advance your Tleilaxu token.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Face Dancer
cards.text:
Face Dancer cost 2 specimens, has Emperor, Spacing Guild, and Fremen faction tags.

You can send an agent to Emperor, Spacing Guild, or Fremen locations. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). Draw 1 card from your deck.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Face Dancer Initiate
cards.text:
Face Dancer Initiate cost 1 specimen, has Emperor, Spacing Guild, and Fremen faction tags.

You can send an agent to Emperor, Spacing Guild, or Fremen locations. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone).

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: From The Tanks
cards.text:
From the Tanks cost 1 specimen.

You can send an agent to Landsraad spaces. Recruit 2 troops.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Ghola
cards.text:
Ghola cost 3 specimens.

You can send an agent to City spaces. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). This card has the same Agent box as the other grafted card.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Guild Impersonator
cards.text:
Guild Impersonator cost 2 specimens, has Spacing Guild faction tag.

You can send an agent to Spacing Guild locations. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). If you gain spice this turn: gain 1 Influence with Spacing Guild.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Industrial Espionage
cards.text:
Industrial Espionage cost 1 specimen.

You can send an agent to Landsraad spaces. Draw 1 card from your deck. If grafted: advance your research token and place a specimen.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Reclaimed Forces
cards.text:
Reclaimed Forces cost 3 specimens. 
On acquire: recruit 2 troops or advance your Tleilaxu token.

(This card is never removed from the Tleilaxu Row.)

cards.name: Scientific Breakthrough
cards.text:
Scientific Breakthrough cost 3 specimens.

You can send an agent to Landsraad, City, or Spice Trade spaces. Advance your research token. If you reach the second genetic marker: you may trash this card to gain 1 victory point.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Slig Farmer
cards.text:
Slig Farmer cost 2 specimens.

You can send an agent to Landsraad spaces. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). Gain 1 solari for each Agent icon on the other grafted card. You may pay 5 solari to advance your Tleilaxu token.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Stitched Horror
cards.text:
Stitched Horror cost 3 specimens.

You can send an agent to City spaces. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). Choose two: gain 1 water, recruit 1 troop, trash card, or advance your Tleilaxu token.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Subject X-137
cards.text:
Subject X-137 cost 2 specimens. 
On acquire: advance your Tleilaxu token.

You can send an agent to Landsraad or Spice Trade spaces. If you reach the first genetic marker: advance your Tleilaxu token.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Tleilaxu Infiltrator
cards.text:
Tleilaxu Infiltrator cost 2 specimens.

You can send an agent to City spaces. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). Enemy Agents don't block your Agent this turn. Draw 1 card from your deck and if you reach the second genetic marker draw 1 Intrigue.

On reveal you gain 1 persuasion.

cards.name: Twisted Mentat
cards.text:
Twisted Mentat cost 3 specimens.

You can send an Agent to Landsraad or City spaces. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). 
You may recall the Agent you sent this turn.

On reveal gain 1 persuasion and 1 specimen.

cards.name: Unnatural Reflexes
cards.text:
Unnatural Reflexes cost 3 specimens.

You can send an Agent to Spice Trade spaces. This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). If you reach the first genetic marker: draw 2 cards from your deck.

On reveal gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.

cards.name: Usurp
cards.text:
Usurp cost 3 specimens.

This card has graft effect (it can't be played alone). You may graft this to a card in the Imperium Row without acquiring it. If you do, trash that card at the end of your turn.

On reveal gain 1 persuasion, 1 sword, and 1 specimen.

cards.name: Piter, Genius Advisor
cards.text:
Piter, Genius Advisor cost 3 specimens.

You can send an Agent to Landsraad or Spice Trade spaces. You may lose a troop to draw 2 cards from your deck and advance your research token one space to the right on the research track.

On reveal gain 1 persuasion and 1 sword.
